p.src: 1  God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

en: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
u.src: 1  God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

p.src: 2  They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

en: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
u.src: 2  They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

p.src: 3  They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

en: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
u.src: 3  They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

p.src: 4  We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

en: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
u.src: 4  We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

p.src: 5  How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

en: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
u.src: 5  How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

p.src: 6  Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
u.src: 6  Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

p.src: 7  for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

en: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
u.src: 7  for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

p.src: 8  Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

en: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
u.src: 8  Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

p.src: 9  Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

en: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
u.src: 9  Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

p.src: 10  Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
u.src: 10  Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

p.src: 11  Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
u.src: 11  Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

p.src: 12  Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

en: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
u.src: 12  Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

p.src: 13  So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

en: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
u.src: 13  So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
